static_traits.name: Luo Li
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, close relationships with parents and siblings
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive friends and family, but recently Reduced socializing due to negative thoughts
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; has not yet experienced similar problems before; has not yet sought psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe feelings and timeline concretely; negative tone, frequently using absolute phrasing (e.g. 'will never win', 'utterly Meaningless'); willing to try Intervention in counseling

basic_info.main_problem: I persistently believe I will never win any money, especially after repeated scratch-off losses; this belief triggers hopelessness and Sense of frustration.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing that this belief markedly affects my emotions and daily activities, therefore seeking counseling to change these thoughts and restore functioning.

core_beliefs: I am destined to fail at the lottery

special_situations.event: Scratching a scratch-off ticket and seeing yet another non-winning result
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I keep not winning, it means I will never win and am doomed to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries changing the approach and seeking advice from friends to turn the situation around
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never win; this is utterly Meaningless; why should I even try

special_situations.event: Experiencing a month of consecutive lottery losses
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I keep losing recently, the future will only get worse, with no change
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuing to play the lottery seeking excitement and hope, trying to ease hopelessness with the next win
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am destined to fail; there will never be anything different

special_situations.event: When Reflecting on losses, focusing only on the non-winning results, treating them as all the evidence
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Losses are all the evidence; any contrary information is irrelevant
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores the broader perspective, evaluates reality only by the most recent failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The evidence is all in those failures; changing views is unrealistic

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain hope and excitement through external good luck or winning a prize, and to feel that their efforts or choices are meaningful
core_conflict.fear: Fear of persistent failure and hopelessness taking over life, worrying that no matter what is done it is all utterly Meaningless
defense_goal: Reducing the chance of being disappointed again through Withdrawal and lowered expectations
Maintaining self-consistency with the 'losses are evidence' framework, avoiding Anxiety from uncertainty

object_relations.self_representation: A hopeless person shrouded in continuous failure
object_relations.object_representation: Supportive but powerless onlookers (family and friends)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites viewing 'loss' from a broader perspective, or presents evidence contrary to their beliefs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting the 'losses are ironclad proof' thinking onto reality, tending to see any counterevidence as denying facts (transference: defending against uncertainty with a rational framework)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Repeats viewpoints in objective statements and 'evidence' wording, tone even but refuses to enter the emotional level; if pressed about feelings, shifts to emphasizing data and results.

manifestations: Forming the belief 'this is utterly Meaningless' after repeated lottery losses
Views recent failure as a permanent state, believing 'doomed to fail'
Withdraws from socializing due to negative thoughts, difficulty falling asleep and disordered eating
outcomes: Worsening hopelessness and Sense of frustration

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeated Self-denial in counseling (e.g. 'why should I even try')
Skeptical of Intervention, hesitating to try ('this may be utterly Meaningless')
Clinging to 'losses' as the sole evidence, cautious and finding it hard to openly engage different perspectives

positive_force: Has supportive friends and family to confide in when encountering difficulties
Overall Work performance not yet significantly affected, occupational functioning basically stable
Can notice the impact of negative beliefs on emotions and life and proactively seeks counseling
Shows willingness in counseling to try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments
negative_force: Cognitive biases of catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and predicting the future reinforcing negative beliefs
Uses the lottery as the main source of excitement and hope, strong external dependence
Social withdrawal leading to fewer supportive interactions
Sleep and eating rhythms disturbed, increased mind-body burden
Repeatedly focuses on failure, treating it as all the evidence (mental filtering)

antecedent: After scratch-off tickets do not win
When thinking about recent consecutive failures
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing recent failures as permanent failure, producing strong hopelessness
target_behavior.function: Avoiding negative emotions and sense of failure
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal connections decrease, support obtained decreases, emotions further worsen

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic Automatic thoughts ('I will never win')
antecedent: After participating in similar gambling activities
target_behavior.core_reason: Cognitive biases of catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and predicting the future driving fixed thinking
target_behavior.function: Trying to lower disappointment by negating expectations in advance

antecedent: After negative Automatic thoughts and hopelessness appear
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent rumination and Low mood causing schedule disruption
target_behavior.function: Coping with uncomfortable emotions through numbness or avoidance
target_behavior.consequence: Physical state and energy decline, affecting work and life
